The CFTC gives a higher level of scrutiny to electronic systems that provide not only trading but also price discovery. That's why we don't refer to the EnronOnline prices reported on the system as "indices" but just average prices. We may be OK here since this is a Canadian price (although its availability to US cutomers my sink us) and it is only for trades where Enron is a party.
